title: [DDL T18] 完善视图生命周期与安全属性

labels.name: ready-for-agent
labels.description: Fully specified and ready for an agent

body:
## Parent

https://github.com/Fanduzi/DeltaScope/issues/79

## What to build

覆盖CREATE/REPLACE/ALTER/DROP VIEW，保留定义依赖和安全相关声明，而不是把有效ALTER VIEW永久当解析错误。

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] 核验每版本厂商语法；为在范围内的有效形状升级parser或提取支持，保持无效语法明确parser_error。
- [ ] 覆盖DEFINER、SQL SECURITY、CHECK OPTION、ALGORITHM及多目标DROP的适用变体；风险结论依赖于可证明事实。
- [ ] 保留引用对象、目标schema与后续依赖变化，外部定义/权限不足给gap，不宣称执行查询或决定授权。
- [ ] 默认禁止/可配置允许场景均有精确语义和no-leak测试，保护任一目标不能绕过。
- [ ] 四anchor适用语法/metadata验证，与Query Access既有视图边界不冲突。

## Blocked by

- https://github.com/Fanduzi/DeltaScope/issues/84

## Execution contract

- Work on the existing milestone branch `milestone/mysql-tidb-ddl-completion`; preserve unrelated changes. No push, tag or release. Each task is a focused commit after its gates.
- The parent spec owns public coverage/version/error contracts. Use shared Audit/SDK semantics; transports test their own status/exit/input/privacy behavior. No adapter-specific semantic copy.
- Use TDD with a failing behavior check, then run applicable corpus/normalizer/rule tests, `make test`, and `make pg-unit-test-gates` when shared/tagged paths are affected. Add applicable isolated DB evidence for the supported version anchors. Finish with Standards + Spec review, affected docs/ADR and no AI co-author trailer.
- Assert statement identity, finding IDs/levels/counts, Verdict/coverage and source locations where relevant. Explicitly distinguish zero findings, disabled/inapplicable checks, evidence gaps and unsupported semantics. Existing broad-pack success alone is insufficient.
- The current 153-probe audit describes failures, not the intended oracle. Add inventory evidence for this slice; never close an in-scope static form merely by labeling it unsupported. Complete sibling results and no-leak contracts remain intact.


<!-- DEVIN_GOLDEN_BEGIN -->
## Devin / Golden Path execution addendum

必须先阅读 [父规格的 Devin 执行约束](https://github.com/Fanduzi/DeltaScope/issues/79#devin-execution-constraints--golden-path-first)，再执行本卡片。父规格保留整体验收，本卡片规定第一个可运行切片。**首条路径通过不代表整单完成**；先让它变绿，再逐项推进本任务的manifest行。

### T18 first Golden Path

- **允许修改的责任范围**：view AST、依赖/声明属性、规则/state与源位置。具体改动仍须能追溯到本路径或其回归；不是目录内任意重构授权。
- **输入前提 / fixture profile**：真实t(id INT)与v，目标版本的ALTER VIEW语法已经官方/DB验证；关闭默认view blanket forbid以检验语义。
- **真实输入**：`ALTER VIEW v AS SELECT id FROM t`
- **独立oracle**：合法MySQL形式不再parser_error；明确target=v和source=t、coverage/政策结论，后续view依赖可用；SQL SECURITY/DEFINER仍保留声明而非凭空授权。
- **必须同时通过的反例**：错误SELECT定义保持失败；缺t的metadata给gap/对应规则，不能因禁用blanket规则而丢掉coverage。
- **本轮非目标**：不执行SELECT、不扩张Query Access能力、不用字符串截取绕开view parser。
- **证明命令**：`make ddl-golden TASK=T18 ARTIFACT_DIR=/tmp/ddl-golden`

**Runner 状态**：T01现在可直接运行；`make ddl-golden`是T02/#81必须交付的新入口，当前基线不存在。后续TASK必须实际构建/调用CLI并校验JSON，不得仅跑内部单测。缺target/零case/缺前置代码/必需DB不可达均失败。不能把命令名存在或exit0当行为已证明。

**每次改动后的顺序**：Golden Path → 最小相关回归 → 下一条case；当前task全部验收完成后才跑全量门禁/评审/提交。不要并行扩展其他ticket。同一blocker两次修改仍存在，停止局部修补，记录尝试并回到最早错误的假设或所有权边界。

**回报必须包含**：Golden Path pass/fail/blocked；确切命令和tested HEAD；实际case/profile数量、JSON/退出码与artifact；root blocker；next smallest change。不得改oracle、删负例、改分母、降级finding、用unsupported代替承诺支持或虚构metadata来变绿。

<!-- DEVIN_GOLDEN_END -->
